name: I want new kitchen flooring—what do I need to do first before I call an installer?

mainEntity.name: I want new kitchen flooring—what do I need to do first before I call an installer?

acceptedAnswer.text: The fastest way to start is to choose the flooring type, measure the kitchen, and schedule an in-home estimate. An installer can then check the subfloor, moisture conditions, transitions, and any demolition or leveling needed before giving a realistic scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start by picking a material, measuring the kitchen, and booking an in-home estimate so the installer can check subfloor condition, moisture, and prep work before quoting the job.
